description: SET LOCALE {LC_ALL | LC_COLLATE | LC_CTYPE | LC_MESSAGES | LC_MONETARY | LC_NUMERIC | LC_TIME}... | USER-DEFAULT TO {identifier-10 | locale-name-1 | USER-DEFAULT | SYSTEM-DEFAULT}, ISO 14.9.39.2 Format 11 (set-locale) - introduced 2002 with the locale facility (Annex A.4.9 item 9; kb/Work PB64 T1). The category brace carries choice indicators (one or more, each at most once, any order - 5.2.6.4). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitSetLocaleStatement): the LC_ shape has no COBOL-85 reading (the underscore is not an '85 word character), so it is recognized at every edition; the USER-DEFAULT-first shape keeps its '85 Format-1 reading below 2002.
vcr: 2002 introduction (the locale facility; kb/Work PB64 T1 - SET LOCALE over the run unit's LocaleState)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PB64SL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    LOCALE FR IS "fr-FR".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET LOCALE LC_COLLATE TO FR.
    STOP RUN.
